mapping.outpoints: rebound, locking scripts and values preserved; signature and absolute-height/time rows excluded

paths.mempool: node sendrawtransaction under its recorded test settings

provenance: synthetic seed corpus; node at the tagged pin on the local private chain; witnesses are unclassified findings
